pr.body:
## Summary

Move Genesis from scheduled Claude-based audits to deterministic daily verification and a private dashboard snapshot.

## Tickets

Closes #39

## Changes

- `.github/workflows/daily-verify.yml`: removes the daily LLM schedule and requires explicit `run_llm` approval.
- `.github/workflows/shadow-agent.yml`: makes LLM rituals opt-in through `SHADOW_LLM_RITUALS=true`.
- `.github/workflows/deterministic-dashboard.yml`: adds the daily model-free verification and private artifact dashboard.
- `.shadow/ci/src/main.rs` and `.shadow/ci/src/verify.rs`: add deterministic GitHub control verification.
- `.shadow/ci/tests/main_test.rs` and `.shadow/ci/tests/verify_test.rs`: cover verifier command behavior.
- `.shadow/site/src/main.rs` and `.shadow/site/tests/main_test.rs`: import verifier evidence into the static SOC 2 dashboard.

## Test Plan

- Added deterministic CLI and verifier unit/integration coverage.
- GitHub Actions compliance, dependency-review, and CodeQL checks run on this PR.
